en: The image shows an old stone building with Byzantine architectural features, including arches, a tiled roof, and narrow windows. The building has a historical and religious appearance, with cypress trees in the background and a few people standing in front. The overall tone is sepia, suggesting the image is from an earlier period. There is a watermark reading 'www.elia.org.gr' on the bottom right.
